svg.title: Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive and more through Google's MCP servers
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the GoogleWorkspace capability opens one connection per selected product to Google's hosted MCP servers, here gmailmcp.googleapis.com and calendarmcp.googleapis.com, with the same OAuth access token. The model sees each server's tools under names that start with the product, such as gmail_search_threads. Your auth function returns the token at the start of each run; the capability does not refresh it, and Google access tokens expire after about an hour.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each product you select is its own hosted MCP server, and one OAuth access token connects to all of them.
